findings.description: Previously `duration` was `minutes * 60`, i.e. seconds. It is now set to `run_time`, which `parse_duration` returns in milliseconds. Consumers such as the scheduler (`Run.seconds`) and the controller's `self._sleep(run.seconds)` treat the value as seconds. Every zone will therefore water for 1000 times its configured time (a 10 minute zone would run for about 167 hours), for both the old `minutes` and the new `duration` formats.
findings.suggestion: Convert to seconds when building the zone, e.g. `duration=run_time / 1000`, or change the field and all its consumers to milliseconds.
findings.title: ZoneConfig.duration changed from seconds to milliseconds
